items.title: Jason Witten's fingerprints have been very good for OU's offense
items.summary: Jason Witten is putting his fingerprints all over the offense. And for the first time in a long time, they're moves that make a lot of sense.

items.title: Jason Witten passes his toughest test yet with flying colors, and strengthens his case for the permanent OC job
items.summary: It took Oklahoma until November to win consecutive football games. All of a sudden, they're a perfect 3-0 and riding high since Jason Witten took over as the offensive playcaller. And a decision that once looked as though it'd be a difficult one for Brent Venables simply continues to appear easier and easier.

items.title: Sooners Stifle Aggies in Home Finale
items.summary: NORMAN, Okla. (AP) — John Mateer overcame a pair of early turnovers by passing for three touchdowns and running for another score, and the Oklahoma defense forced eight punts in a 28-7 win over Texas A&M on Saturday.

items.title: Oklahoma WR commit Greydon Howell leads Broken Bow to epic upset of Weatherford: "You just gotta survive"
items.summary: Just how transcendent of a talent is Greydon Howell? Weatherford entered Oklahoma's 4A quarterfinals at a perfect 11-0, boasting a punishing defense that hadn't allowed more than 20 points in a game all season. And then Howell and Broken Bow rolled into town on Friday night and dropped a 50-burger.

items.title: In the SEC, Who Follows Georgia?
items.summary: The SEC is nearing the end of its season-long run and while most have the Georgia Bulldogs on top, who comes behind them? Is there any way to separate teams 3-10? We take a look at the best of the rest in the SEC.

items.title: Anderson Named Mannelly Award Semifinalist
items.summary: NORMAN — For the third straight season, University of Oklahoma long snapper Ben Anderson has been named a semifinalist for the Patrick Mannelly Award, which is presented to the nation's best long snapper, the award organization announced Monday evening.

items.title: Complementary Football Lifts OU Past No. 19 Ole Miss
items.summary: NORMAN, Okla. (AP) — John Mateer accounted for 181 yards of offense and Oklahoma held on to beat No. 19 Mississippi 24-17 on Sunday, a day after the Southeastern Conference game was originally scheduled to be played.

items.title: OU Announces Football Fan-Appreciation Promotions, Alterations to Other Sunday Events
items.summary: NORMAN — The University of Oklahoma Athletics Department has announced fan-appreciation promotions for Sunday's football game against Ole Miss that was rescheduled by the SEC, as well as date and/or time changes for OU's other three home athletics events originally scheduled for Sunday.

items.title: OU-Ole Miss Football Game Moved to Sunday at Noon
items.summary: NORMAN — The Southeastern Conference announced Friday night that Oklahoma's home football game against Ole Miss that was scheduled for Saturday at 3:15 p.m. CT will now kick off on Sunday at noon. TV information has yet to be determined.
